page.overview:
Who is Cúchulainn?

Cúchulainn (70px), also known as Queklain,, is a antagonist from Final Fantasy Tactics. Associated with the Scorpio auracite, he is the first Lucavi demon that Ramza Beoulve fights.

Cúchulainn is one of the Lucavi, a supernatural demonic race originating from another dimension connected to the world of Ivalice. Although it is uncertain whether he participated in his leader Ultima's initial effort to sow chaos in Ivalice during the prevailing period of the Holy Ydoran Empire, according to the legend of the Zodiac Braves, Ultima intended to gather her companions through the auracites that she supposedly created through her host, Ajora Glabados. However, she was ultimately prevented from achieving her goal due to Ajora's capture and execution as a result of the actions of her treacherous disciple, Germonique.

1200 years after Ultima's defeat and imprisonment within the body of her vessel, the twelve auracites that Saint Ajora and his disciples were said to have wielded as the Zodiac Braves have been scattered throughout Ivalice, which was once again at war, this time between two duchies vying for the throne and control of the kingdom. Because the Church of Glabados had distorted the story of Ajora's life to conceal his true nature, his devotees were unaware of the Stones' ability to possess their bearers.

At some point, Cúchulainn possessed Cardinal Alphonse Delacroix after he obtained the Scorpio Stone, although the circumstances of how this happened, and for how long he was under Cúchulainn's influence, are unknown. He followed Hashmal's leadership—who was possessing the Knights Templar leader, Folmarv Tengille—in an effort to resurrect Ultima through a complex ritual that specifically required an immense bloodshed to be performed. To accomplish this, both used their influence over the Church through their hosts to orchestrate the War of the Lions, while also searching for the remaining Zodiac Stones so they could find potential candidates who could be possessed by their brethren to aid them in their plans.
